records.title: Senior Manager, QMS - Manufacturing
records.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

The Senior Manager, Quality Management Systems (QMS) will lead the development, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Crusoe's enterprise Quality Management System across multiple manufacturing facilities, supplier operations, subcontractors, and field deployment activities.

This individual will be responsible for establishing a scalable, standardized, risk-based QMS that enables consistent product quality, manufacturing process control, regulatory and customer compliance, and operational excellence across the organization.

The role will provide strategic and operational leadership for QMS governance, internal and external audits, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), document and records management, quality processes, compliance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Senior Manager will lead and develop a team of QMS professionals, auditors, and documentation specialists while partnering closely with Product Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Field Quality leadership.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of progressive Quality Management System experience, including substantial people-management experience in complex manufacturing environments. This individual must be capable of translating quality standards and business requirements into practical operating processes that improve manufacturing effectiveness, prevent defects, reduce operational risks, and support organizational growth.

The ultimate objective is to establish a proactive, business-enabling QMS that drives consistency, accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement across Crusoe's growing AI Data Center infrastructure manufacturing and deployment ecosystem.

 

What You'll Be Working On:

 - Enterprise QMS Strategy, Governance & Leadership
   
   - Own and lead the enterprise Quality Management System strategy, architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.
   
   - Establish and maintain a scalable QMS aligned with ISO 9001:2015 and applicable customer, regulatory, contractual, and industry requirements.
   
   - Develop standardized Quality policies, procedures, processes, work instructions, forms, and records applicable across all manufacturing facilities and operational functions.
   
   - Establish QMS governance, process ownership, accountability matrices, escalation mechanisms, and management review processes.
   
   - Ensure consistent implementation of Quality Management System requirements across Brighton, Tulsa-1, Tulsa-2, Arvada, Ponchatoula, and other future manufacturing and operational locations.
   
   - Establish a process-based, risk-oriented approach to quality management rather than a documentation-driven compliance culture.
   
   - Partner with Quality leadership to establish annual QMS objectives, strategic initiatives, resource plans, and performance targets.
   
   - Lead QMS maturity assessments and develop roadmaps to strengthen process effectiveness and organizational readiness.
   
   - Ensure QMS requirements are appropriately integrated into product development, manufacturing, supplier management, and field operations.

 -  ISO Compliance & Audit Management
   
   - Own the enterprise internal and external audit program, including audit planning, scheduling, execution, reporting, and follow-up.
   
   - Maintain organizational readiness for ISO 9001 certification, surveillance audits, recertification audits, and customer or third-party audits.
   
   - Lead and oversee internal audits across manufacturing, engineering, procurement, supplier quality, production, inspection, testing, and field operations.
   
   - Ensure audit programs evaluate actual process implementation and effectiveness rather than merely verifying documentation.
   
   - Manage relationships with external certification bodies, registrars, customer auditors, and regulatory or industry assessment organizations.
   
   - Establish risk-based audit schedules considering process criticality, historical performance, operational changes, and previous audit findings.
   
   - Ensure audit findings are appropriately classified, assigned, investigated, corrected, and closed within established timelines.
   
   - Verify corrective action effectiveness and prevent recurrence of systemic audit findings.
   
   - Develop and maintain qualified internal auditor resources across multiple facilities and functions.

 - CAPA, Nonconformance & Continuous Improvement
   
   - Establish and govern enterprise-wide CAPA, nonconformance, deviation, and quality escalation processes.
   
   - Ensure effective root cause analysis using structured methodologies such as 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, fault tree analysis, and other appropriate problem-solving techniques.
   
   - Drive accountability for corrective and preventive actions across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Operations.
   
   - Monitor CAPA aging, overdue actions, recurrence rates, effectiveness verification, and systemic trends.
   
   - Identify recurring process failures, systemic weaknesses, and opportunities for organizational improvement.
   
   - Establish standardized requirements for nonconformance documentation, containment, disposition, investigation, and closure.
   
   - Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that reduce process variation, eliminate waste, improve first-pass yield, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
   
   - Ensure lessons learned from internal defects, supplier issues, customer complaints, and field failures are incorporated into the QMS.

 - QMS Documentation & Records Management
   
   - Own enterprise document and records management governance.
   
   - Establish standardized requirements for document creation, review, approval, release, revision control, distribution, retention, and obsolescence.
   
   - Ensure controlled management of Quality Manuals, policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, inspection plans, test procedures, forms, and quality records.
   
   - Implement effective document control processes across multiple facilities and functional organizations.
   
   - Ensure personnel have access to current and approved documentation at the point of use.
   
   - Establish document ownership and periodic review requirements.
   
   - Eliminate uncontrolled documentation, obsolete work instructions, inconsistent forms, and duplicate processes.
   
   - Drive adoption and effective utilization of electronic QMS platforms and digital document management solutions.
   
   - Ensure objective evidence and records are maintained to demonstrate process conformity and effectiveness.

 - Risk Management & Operational Quality Governance
   
   - Establish enterprise-level Quality risk management processes.
   
   - Ensure risk-based thinking is incorporated into business processes, product realization, supplier management, manufacturing operations, and field activities.
   
   - Oversee QMS-related risk assessments and coordinate with functional leaders on DFMEA, PFMEA, process risk assessments, and operational controls.
   
   - Establish escalation mechanisms for significant Quality risks, process deviations, regulatory concerns, and potential customer impacts.
   
   - Ensure changes to products, processes, suppliers, equipment, and organizational structures are appropriately evaluated for QMS impact.
   
   - Drive management review processes that evaluate QMS performance, organizational risks, customer satisfaction, audit results, CAPA effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.

 - Multi-Site Standardization & Deployment
   
   - Establish a consistent enterprise QMS framework while allowing controlled, documented site-specific requirements where necessary.
   
   - Lead QMS deployment, implementation, and maturity improvement across existing and new manufacturing facilities.
   
   - Partner with site Quality leaders to ensure standardized processes are effectively implemented and sustained.
   
   - Conduct periodic site assessments to evaluate QMS effectiveness, process adherence, and compliance maturity.
   
   - Establish cross-site benchmarking and sharing of best practices.
   
   - Ensure new manufacturing facilities and acquired or outsourced operations are incorporated into the enterprise QMS framework.
   
   - Develop standardized QMS deployment and operational readiness plans for new facilities.

 - Customer, Supplier & Regulatory Quality Support
   
   - Partner with Supplier Quality leadership to ensure QMS requirements are incorporated into supplier qualification, supplier audits, corrective actions, and supplier performance management.
   
   - Ensure subcontractors and outsourced manufacturing partners operate under appropriate Quality requirements and controls.
   
   - Support customer audits, quality assessments, and contractual compliance requirements.
   
   - Ensure effective management of customer complaints, quality escapes, and external nonconformances through the enterprise CAPA framework.
   
   - Partner with Product and Manufacturing Quality to ensure appropriate quality planning and process controls are established.
   
   - Maintain awareness of applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and customer-specific Quality requirements relevant to electrical and mechanical infrastructure manufacturing.

 - People Leadership & Organizational Development
   
   - Build, lead, and develop a high-performing QMS organization.
   
   - Directly manage QMS personnel, including QMS Leads, Quality Auditors, QMS Documentation Specialists, and other assigned Quality professionals.
   
   - Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and individual development plans.
   
   - Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, talent assessments, and succession planning.
   
   - Develop technical and leadership competencies within the QMS organization.
   
   - Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
   
   - Establish effective working relationships with site Quality leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
   
   - Identify resource requirements and develop headcount and organizational plans to support current and future business growth.
   
   - Mentor and develop future Quality leaders and technical subject matter experts.

 - Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Establishing, monitoring, and improving measurable QMS performance indicators, including:
   
   - QMS Compliance
   
   - Audit Management
   
   - CAPA Effectiveness
   
   - Document Control
   
   - Multi-Site Standardization
   
   - Process Effectiveness
   
   - Organizational Development
   
   - Customer Quality
   
   - Continuous Improvement



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Educational Foundation: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline. 

 - Professional Experience: 
   
   - 7+ Years of Dedicated Experience in QMS, plus additional experience in Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Assurance. 
   
   - 5+ Years of People Leadership Experience: Including managing and developing Quality professionals and technical teams (these years may overlap with the 10+ above).  

 - QMS Expertise: Demonstrated experience owning, implementing, and improving enterprise or multi-site Quality Management Systems.

 - ISO 9001 Expertise: Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 requirements and certification processes.

 - Core Quality Methodologies: Demonstrated expertise in CAPA, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and continuous improvement.

 - Quality Documentation & Document Control: Experience developing and implementing Quality policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, and document control systems.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience managing cross-functional Quality initiatives across Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Supply Chain.

 - Risk & Process Management: Strong understanding of risk-based thinking, process management, and operational excellence.

 - eQMS Implementation: Experience implementing or administering electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).

 - Influence & Accountability: Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational accountability without relying solely on hierarchical authority.

 - Communication & Analytical Skills: Excellent written, verbal, analytical, organizational, and presentation skills.

 - Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility; drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.
   
    

Bonus Points:

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. JOB DESCRIPTION:

 

Shield AI builds autonomy systems for defense applications, including air, maritime, and space platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

We are building the AI Factory Reference Architecture, a Kubernetes-native platform for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying next-generation AI systems.

The AI Factory serves two purposes. Internally, it powers autonomy development across Hivemind and other AI programs. Externally, it becomes the reference architecture deployed into customer environments, spanning commercial cloud, on-premise infrastructure, sovereign deployments, and fully air-gapped systems.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to help define and build this platform. You will partner closely with ML researchers, platform engineers, and autonomy teams to deliver an exceptional developer experience for training and deploying modern AI models.

Success in this role requires balancing researcher productivity, platform simplicity, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability. You will work hands-on across the stack, helping shape both the platform architecture and its implementation while staying closely aligned with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - AI Platform Development: Lead the design and implementation of the AI Factory Reference Architecture, delivering a Kubernetes-native platform for AI development, distributed training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment.

 - AI Research Enablement: Partner directly with ML researchers to understand evolving training workflows and ensure the platform supports state-of-the-art AI frameworks, foundation model development, reinforcement learning, distributed training, and emerging research workflows.

 - Developer Experience: Design self-service AI development workflows that enable engineers to move seamlessly from local experimentation to large-scale distributed execution using familiar open source tools and frameworks.

 - Distributed AI Infrastructure: Build the infrastructure required to support distributed training, simulation, inference, and reinforcement learning workloads. Evaluate and integrate orchestration, scheduling, and resource management technologies to maximize scalability and developer productivity.

 - Compute Platform: Design and optimize shared GPU infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. Improve resource utilization, scheduling efficiency, storage, networking, observability, and overall platform reliability.

 - Data & Model Lifecycle: Build platform capabilities that enable dataset management, experiment tracking, artifact management, model versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement.

 - Platform Distribution: Develop repeatable deployment and lifecycle management solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices. Support commercial cloud, customer-managed infrastructure, sovereign environments, and fully air-gapped deployments.

 - Technology Leadership: Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and establish architectural patterns that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, autonomy teams, infrastructure engineers, and product teams to ensure the platform evolves alongside customer needs and advances in AI.

Key Outcomes:

 - 

 - Engineers move from idea to distributed training in hours instead of days.

 - High GPU utilization through efficient scheduling with KAI on Kubernetes.

 - Researchers use modern AI tooling without unnecessary platform friction.

 - AI Workspaces become the standard development environment across autonomy programs.

 - Training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment operate as a unified platform.

 - The AI Factory Reference Architecture can be deployed consistently across cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped environments.

 - Platform capabilities are reusable across multiple autonomy programs and customer deployments.

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience building Kubernetes-native AI or MLOps platforms supporting distributed machine learning workloads.

 - Deep understanding of modern AI training frameworks, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and distributed training techniques.

 - Experience operating GPU-accelerated infrastructure and distributed training systems.

 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, networking, security, storage, and distributed systems.

 - Experience with GPU scheduling concepts and large-scale AI workloads.

 - Experience packaging and deploying cloud-native infrastructure using Terraform and Helm.

 - Strong software engineering skills in Python and Golang and modern cloud-native technologies.

 - Experience collaborating closely with ML researchers to translate research workflows into scalable platform capabilities.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience with Ray or other distributed AI orchestration frameworks.

 - Experience with KAI, Slurm or other GPU scheduling technologies.

 - Experience supporting reinforcement learning, simulation-driven training, robotics, or autonomy workloads.

 - Experience deploying and optimizing AI models for edge hardware.

 - Experience designing infrastructure for classified, sovereign, or air-gapped environments.

 - Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.

 - Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure projects.

Why Join Us

 - The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.
   
   As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will help build the reference architecture used internally by our engineering teams and delivered to customers building their own AI capabilities. Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.
   
   This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of modern AI, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and defense, building a platform that enables the next generation of autonomy systems while leveraging the best of the open-source AI ecosystem.

You will own assembly, diagnostics, testing, and End-of-Line (EOL), and help carry new vehicles into serial production.
Prototype builds surface new hardware and software issues every day. Success in this role depends on working closely with hardware and software engineering teams to resolve them fast, so you can meet production goals. You will set priorities, hold owners accountable, and escalate decisively when an issue blocks the build.
Reporting to the Senior Director of Manufacturing Engineering and General Assembly, you will be a key leader in Zoox Manufacturing Operations. You will partner closely with Vehicle Development, Software, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and the teams operating our test fleet.
In this role, you will:
Own diagnostics, functional testing, and EOL validation. Deliver vehicles to fleet and engineering teams safely, complete, and on time.
Implement repeatable build processes and keep accurate hardware and software configuration records for every vehicle. Ensure each vehicle meets quality and product specifications.
Prepare and manage the line's OPEX, CAPEX, and headcount budgets. Identify investments that improve throughput, quality, and flexibility.
Ensure MES and QMS support prototype builds, including traceability and issue tracking. Drive continuous improvement through the Zoox Production System.
Hire, train, and develop technicians, leads, and supervisors. Set clear expectations and evaluate performance.
Build a culture that puts employee and product safety first, in partnership with EHS. Enforce safe practices for high-voltage systems and pre-production vehicles.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Management, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in vehicle or complex electromechanical assembly manufacturing (e.g., automotive, aerospace, robotics), including prototype, pilot, or NPI builds.
5+ years of experience leading production teams, including supervisors or managers.
Proven ability to lead hardware and software engineers to resolve build issues under schedule pressure, often without direct authority.
Working knowledge of vehicle systems (mechanical, electrical, high-voltage, embedded software) and how they are built, diagnosed, and tested.
Experience transitioning new products from prototype into serial production.
Familiarity with MES, ERP, and QMS, and with structured problem-solving (e.g., 8D, root cause analysis).
Clear communicator who can present build status, risks, and trade-offs to executives.
Bonus Qualifications
Experience with autonomous, electric, or other software-defined vehicles.
Experience building or retrofitting R&D or test-fleet vehicles.
Experience applying lean principles in low-volume, high-mix production.

records.title: Deputy Head of Production, Connected Warfare
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE SITE 

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1 , its first hyperscale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed that autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening America’s warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.



 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Connected Warfare will set the standard for building the future at Arsenal-1 , our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Ashville, OH. This team will have the opportunity to train under our world-class manufacturing team at Anduril HQ in Costa Mesa, CA for 3 months before bringing that standard of excellence back to Ohio.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 

 As the Connected Warfare Deputy Head of Production, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of defense manufacturing by directly influencing the production of Anduril’s Connected Warfare product line. Working as a right hand to the Head of Production, you will own the short-to-mid-term strategic development and execution of manufacturing operations, driving products from NPI to full-rate production. This role requires a dynamic leader who can serve as both a strategic architect and a hands-on executor, leading cross-functional teams to meet aggressive timelines and deliver products of the highest quality for our customers. You will contribute significantly to Anduril’s vision of becoming a next-generation aerospace and defense manufacturer.

 

 What You'll Do: 

 
 Production Ownership & Strategy: Own all production outcomes for the Connected Warfare product line, including ramp plans, headcount, and the standing up of new manufacturing lines. Develop and execute a strategy to rapidly scale production volumes f rom NPI to full-rate production.

 Leadership & Team Management: Serve as a strategic leader and tactical do-er, driving all people and resources across production to achieve outcomes. Lead cross-functional teams (including Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing Engineering) through strong leadership, advocacy, and a consistent on-site presence, holding them accountable to meeting demands, deadlines, and goals.

 Operational Excellence: Drive processes and systems needed throughout the product development lifecycle to mature products to full-rate production. Establish and manage the team to key performance indicators (KPIs) for financial, quality, and on-time delivery, and partner on production budgets and cost targets to optimize manufacturing operations’ impact on the business.

 Quality & Compliance: Be accountable to AS9100D guidelines and drive a “quality-first” culture across all manufacturing operations.

 Process & Technology Advancement: Advise on development and oversee the implementation of digital technologies, from PLM and ERP to our custom MES and QMS systems, that enable our production operations to efficiently scale while meeting customer requirements. Shape corporate tools and processes to support the unique needs of aerospace production.

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 8+ years of proven experience overseeing the production and test of complex electromechanical products.

 Strong leadership experience managing large (100+ person) manufacturing teams and directing large cross-functional teams across planning, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, quality, and production to deliver products of the highest quality.

 A strong background in quality assurance, with a track record of driving a "quality-first" culture in a production environment and accountability to standards like AS9100D.

 Past success operating in both low-rate prototype and high-rate manufacturing environments, with a proven ability to scale production.

 High ownership and the ability to effectively manage multiple large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at our Asheville, OH campus (Arsenal 1).

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 
 Success scaling production operations in a high-complexity manufacturing environment.

 Deep experience with the niche supply chains for aerospace and robotics.

 Demonstrated experience implementing and leveraging digital manufacturing technologies (PLM, ERP, MES, QMS) to drive efficiency and scale.

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $190,000 — $252,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

records.title: Deputy Head of Production, Intelligence Systems
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Intelligence Systems team is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

 ABOUT THE JOB 
We are seeking a director to coordinate all of our production operations across Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS). The Deputy Head of Production for AIS owns short to mid-term (1-3 years) strategic development and execution, operational direction, career pathing, and vision for a product or suite of Anduril products. Your job will be to provide consistent, flawless execution for a variety of product and programs. 

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 
 Own all Production outcomes such as, ramp plan, NPI, Headcount, etc.

 Drive all people and resources to drive all production outcomes.

 Serve as the leader for Manufacturing Engineering, Production Test Engineering, and Manufacturing Operations.

 Serve as both a strategic leader and tactical do-er for Anduril’s rapidly growing production operations for a product or suite of products.

 Hold cross functional teams accountable to meeting demands, deadlines and goals to deliver the production on time and within budget.

 Drive Production, Supply Chain, and Quality, teams to build and execute upon Anduril’s 5-year strategic vision to become a next-generation aerospace and defense manufacturer, capable of full rate production.

 Deliver production outcomes as the products mature from production development to full rate production.

 Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Deployment Operations, and Program Management to execute success.

 Mature products from low rate prototypes to full rate production by driving processes and systems as needed throughout the product development lifecycle.

 Establish and manage team to financial, quality, and on-time delivery KPIs to understand how our manufacturing operations are impacting our business.

 Advise on development and oversee implementation of digital technologies, from PLM and ERP to our custom MES and QMS systems, that enable our production operations to efficiently scale while meeting customer requirements.

 Be accountable to AS9100D guidelines.

 Be a partner to the Head of Production and the VP of Production for AIS.

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 5+ years in a Production leadership role within an electronics based industry. A track record of successfully scaling products from prototype to full rate production is preferred.

 Bachelor of Science or higher degree in a technical discipline preferred, not required.

 3+ years of experience managing a P&L in a Production environment.

 Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Clearance.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret Clearance.

 Experience with automation and testing for electronics and assembly (PCBA testing, vision systems, conveyance, fastener installation).

 Experience managing a workforce of large production teams across quality, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, test engineering and manufacturing operations.

 Relentless drive for continuous improvement and solving high impact business problems through highly leveraged process, business systems, and data.

 Strong outcome orientation with the ability to drive initiatives from inception to implementation and adoption. Willing and able to dive into tactical execution mode when needed to move the effort forward.

 Ability to work with engineering on a technical level.

 Positive and inspirational leader with the demonstrated ability to assess, attract and retain high-quality talent and build high-performing teams.

 Sophisticated interpersonal ability to earn credibility, influence others, change minds, and advise across diverse environments and personalities.

 Demonstrated strategic thinking abilities and the ability to see around corners.

 Strong problem solving and analytic skills with the ability to understand how problems and their solutions fit with the wider organization and its operations.

records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 About the role

 The Director, Manufacturing Analytics owns Manufacturing Analytics globally: every site, every product line, and every Manufacturing function across Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Planning, and Warehousing / Material Management. The ambition is not better dashboards. It is that a division leader can tell whether they will hit rate before they miss it, and that when we argue about where to invest, the argument is settled by data rather than by whoever presents best.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 This is a player-coach role. You will lead the hardest analytical problems yourself, on the programs that matter most to the company, and build a team that can run several more in parallel. You will be judged on what you accomplish, not on how you operate: whether a program hit rate that would otherwise have slipped, whether a constraint got cleared because we saw it coming, whether a number leadership used to make a real decision came from this team.
We weigh approach over domain familiarity. The strongest analytics leaders we have are exceptional at how they attack a problem, even where they arrived without the functional background. Manufacturing depth is useful and listed below as preferred, but it does not substitute for analytical method, judgment about what matters, and the ability to drive a result through an organization.

 What you'll do

 
 Apply analytics to manufacturing’s biggest problems. Hold an evidence-backed view of what is worth the company's attention and in what order, rather than working a request list. Take the hardest two or three problems in Anduril's flagship programs and build analytics into them end to end, hands-on.

 Make the various business units in Anduril decide earlier. Shift Manufacturing reporting from retrospective to leading: risk surfaced two months before the gate, not status recited on the day of it. Adoption is the deliverable. A correct dashboard nobody opens has failed.

 Turn what worked into the enterprise standard. Generalize proven capabilities into supported products, standardize the definitions the work proved out, and consolidate the duplicated reporting they replace. A standard that survives contact with a program running at rate is defensible. One written in a document is not.

 Answer what it takes to scale. Own the analytical side of a ramp from low rate to high rate, and keep a current, evidenced view of the constraints that actually bind as the company grows.

 Build the team and the foundation. Lead the consolidated analytics organization and the managers within it. Build on and in the Manufacturing process/team rather than beside them. Hold the line that the various business units own master data quality while the analytics team builds the tooling that makes defects visible and cheap to fix.

 Your work should produce numbers the business can trust. Where a metric is known to be wrong, it is a defect with an owner and a date, not a caveat on a slide. Fix the data before building on top of it.

 
 Required qualifications

 
 10+ years in analytics, data, or quantitative operations, including 5+ years leading analytics or data teams, and experience managing managers or clear readiness to do so.

 A rigorous, teachable approach to ambiguous problems. You can describe how you decide what to work on, how you structure an analysis, how you know when you're wrong, and how you install that method in a team.

 Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL and a modern data stack, able to get into a dataset personally, find the answer, and defend the method. This role does not succeed as pure management.

 Demonstrated ability to identify the highest-value problem in a messy operational environment and solve it analytically.

 A track record you can point at: specific operational outcomes your work caused, with the numbers, the program, and the skeptics named.

 Experience shipping analytics as supported products with real users, and retiring what they replace.

 Able to influence business unit and functional leadership peer-to-peer without authority, and to work credibly with a program team that starts out unconvinced.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. U.S. person status required per ITAR/EAR.

 
 Preferred qualifications

 
 Operational depth in manufacturing, supply chain, or planning, including fluency with routings, work orders, MRP exceptions, and cycle counts.

 Analytical ownership of a Manufacturing ramp from low rate to high rate.

 Experience building an analytics function from a scattered starting point, consolidating people, standards, and tooling that previously sat under separate owners.

 Databricks and Palantir Foundry, dimensional modeling and semantic or ontology layers.

 High-rate or high-mix manufacturing, defense Manufacturing, or another environment scaling volume fast.

records.title: Head of Business Line Operations - Tactical Effects
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Tactical Recon and Strike (TRS) team at Anduril develops aerial small drones (Group 1-3) and all equipment to test, deploy and operate. The team is responsible for taking products like Ghost, Bolt, Anvil, and Altius from paper sketches to operational systems. The Tactical Effects Team is a cornerstone business line of the TRS group that is going through tremendous growth. We work in close coordination with specialist teams to solve some of the hardest problems facing our customers. The TRS Operations team is a small but mighty team of business generalists who ‘solve for scale’ the specific business problems that hamper efficiency or productivity. One project may have you solving staffing inefficiencies across engineering teams, while another project may have you working across manufacturing, supply chain, and quality teams to help address capacity or production challenges. We are looking for the Head of Operations to support our Ghost and Precision Engagement Systems business lines, based in Costa Mesa, CA.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Own all aspects of business operations and infrastructure, ensuring business development, engineering, and production teams have what they need when they need it to execute

 Serve as the General Manager’s chief strategist to balance resource and execution risk against our massive growth plans, regularly monitoring financials to help guide us toward our profitability targets

 Translate growth signals into demand across all operational infrastructure including staffing, real estate, test ranges, classified infrastructure, and production and collaborate with cross-functional partners across Anduril to deliver

 Own the business line’s governance structure from business reviews to annual planning and employee onboarding to all hands, developing and evolving information pathways as the organization scales

 Collaborate closely with division leadership to evolve the organizational structure and define and implement strong hiring, onboarding, and execution standards for key functions so we maintain a culture of “doing things differently”

 Execute on special projects, evolve internal processes, spearhead the stand up of new functions, and lead M&A efforts as needed

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 You have 5-7+ years of varied experience in an operating role at a high-growth technology company, starting a venture, or in finance or consulting

 You love solving complex, ambiguous, cross-functional problems in a people-centric way

 You’re both high ownership and low ego, approaching everything with strong outcome orientation and high humility

 You’re highly detail oriented and data-driven

 You’re discerning and an incredibly fast learner

 You’re tactical and enjoy getting into the details.

 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.  Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology.  As the Head of Manufacturing Test Engineering, you will play a pivotal leadership role in defining and executing the manufacturing test strategy across Anduril's rapidly expanding global manufacturing footprint. You are charged with establishing and scaling rigorous testing protocols for our high-volume, technologically advanced products, with a specific emphasis on complex mechanical, electrical, and propulsion systems. Your strategic leadership will ensure the consistent delivery of superior quality products to our customers worldwide, while meeting ambitious manufacturing throughput requirements.  Provide strong, inspirational leadership to a high-performing global engineering team, fostering innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 Serve as a key executive liaison, adeptly communicating strategic visions and technical roadmaps to senior leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, and global partners to influence key decisions.

 Drive cutting-edge innovation in test methodologies and infrastructure, specializing in complex electro-mechanical assemblies, advanced electrical systems, and propulsion technologies, focusing on automation, standardization, and operational streamlining.

 Lead the strategic design, procurement, and implementation of test infrastructure and equipment, ensuring robust capabilities for diverse hardware complexities while optimizing cost-benefit and ROI.

 Collaborate extensively with R&D, product development, and manufacturing teams to integrate design-for-testability principles early in the product lifecycle, enhancing manufacturability and global production readiness.

 Champion initiatives that drive operational excellence, including enhancing safety, reducing costs, improving quality, and increasing productivity across all manufacturing test operations.

 Establish robust data analytics frameworks and reporting structures to provide actionable insights for strategic decision-making, continuous product/process enhancement, and performance optimization across the enterprise.

 Implement comprehensive training, documentation, and proactive maintenance strategies to elevate team expertise, facilitate knowledge transfer, and ensure equipment uptime across the global footprint.

 Act as the ultimate technical authority and strategic advisor for all manufacturing test matters, guiding complex problem-solving and long-range planning.

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

 Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing test engineering, with a proven track record of developing, deploying, and scaling high-volume, complex system production operations across multiple global sites.

 Profound expertise in the testing of complex electro-mechanical assemblies, advanced electrical systems, and propulsion technologies.

 Proven ability to lead, mentor, and inspire large, diverse engineering teams, fostering professional growth and high performance.

 Exceptional executive presence, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical strategies to non-technical audiences.

 Strong financial acumen, including experience managing large departmental budgets and strategic capital expenditures.

 Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, quality systems, and reliability engineering principles in high-volume, fast-paced environments.

 Strong analytical skills for root cause analysis of non-conforming hardware and process deviations.

 Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES).

 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in a relevant engineering discipline or MBA.

 Proven experience in establishing and expanding global manufacturing test capabilities, including greenfield site development.

 Familiarity with test automation software platforms and programming languages (e.g., Python, C#, LabVIEW, MATLAB) for high-level system integration and data analysis.

 Expertise in designing and specifying test fixtures and equipment for challenging mechanical, electrical, and propulsion components.

 Strong knowledge of reliability and environmental testing (HASS, ESS, thermal cycling, vibration, shock) specifically for advanced physical systems.

 Experience with various hardware communication protocols relevant to complex system integration.

 Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

records.title: Head of Operations, Intelligence Systems
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to join our rapidly growing Intelligence Systems team. In this role you will be responsible for all business operations for the business line you support. Your work will vary from quick-turn operational fire-fighting, to building and redesigning processes, to leading high-impact strategic projects. This role requires you to be a trusted partner to each part of the business, and to work with and support the Division leadership teams to achieve our strategic objectives.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Partner to the GM — Serve as the right hand to the General Manager of Intelligence Systems, responsible for all internal operations of the business line.

 Act as COO of the business line — Drive day-to-day business operations for Intelligence Systems. This includes business planning & organization design, financial tracking, talent planning & people operations, staffing and hiring, corporate governance, go-to-market, real estate & facility planning, security & infrastructure compliance, proposal & legal support, and sharing the division's narrative — working with cross-functional partners across each of these domains.

 Lead the BizOps team — Lead the Business Operations team within Intelligence Systems, composed of a Business Execution/Services team and Business Analytics, with the potential to include Production Operations/Analytics.

 Own the bottom line — Own the business line P&L and burn rate. Partner with Finance and FP&A to track financial health against division goals, take action to keep operating expenses within budget, and recommend strategies to drive toward margin targets.

 Define growth strategy — Define the growth strategy for Intelligence Systems in partnership with the Intelligence Systems Leadership Team, and lead strategic initiatives in line with business line priorities.

 Enable the engineering mission — Support the growth, execution, and engineering of the business line with operational support.

 Scale the organization — Problem solve to enable the business line to operate as efficiently as possible and scale accordingly.

 Represent the business externally — Build senior leader engagement and external interface strategy (e.g., conferences, press releases, partnerships).

 Build partnerships — Build, negotiate, and execute partnerships across industry.

 Support M&A activity — Identify targets and engage in diligence.

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 10-15+ years of professional experience in operations.

 Strong communication skills; trusted by executives and colleagues alike — Demonstrated ability to translate and articulate thoughts clearly and simply across a wide range of roles (software engineers, finance partners, recruiters, cross-functional leadership, and executives). Communications excellence across a wide dynamic range, both written and verbal. Experience interfacing with company leadership and executives is a must, with a demonstrated ability to cultivate trust, facilitate meetings for, and engage with executives.

 Technically minded — Solid technical aptitude and proven ability to understand technical designs, and the ability to work closely and effectively with engineering teams.

 Bridges operational and analytical teams — Strong emotional intelligence and ability to solve operational problems in a way that is both data-driven and people-centric.

 High ownership and capacity — Horsepower to effectively manage multiple (6+) large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Finance literate — Comfortable owning a bottom line, reading and acting on P&L, budget, and margin data in partnership with FP&A.

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at either our Reston, VA office or our HQ in Costa Mesa, CA.

 Minimum 25% travel expected.

 Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 MBA or similar degree.

 Experience working with engineers and bringing hardware/software products to market strongly preferred.

 Experience in the intelligence community or national security mission space

 Experience leading a business operations, business analytics, or similar function

 Experience working effectively in a matrix organization structure.

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field.

 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Air Dominance and Strike Division is one of Anduril’s fastest growing, most technically complex divisions. We develop and build collaborative combat aircraft , missiles, and the software that powers these autonomous weapons. We are looking for a Program Director to be part of the leadership team on one of Anduril’s largest production programs. As a Program Director you will lead a significant portion of the product line and will be directly responsible for all elements of cost and schedule performance in assigned area.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 
 Strategic Thinking and Decomposition: Ability to understand the long term objectives of the business, successfully develop a winning strategy that maximizes business objectives, and decompose into near term and long term plans.

 Execution focused - digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program management, and leadership skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.

 Finical and Business Acumen: Understand the fundamentals of the business and develop KPIs and goals for departments and teams that drive real outcomes

 Collaborative partnership - managing customer relationships and shaping the future of the program with the government.

 
 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Own the overall financial performance and schedule for the production segment of the business

 Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from internal engineering, customers, and third party corporate partners to own successful delivery of outcomes on multiple programs simultaneously

 Understanding the long term objectives of the business, develop winning strategies that result in meeting Anduril’s business objectives while service the customers needs

 Develop strong, trusting relationships with Anduril’s DOD customers, ensuring we have tight feedback loops that enable us shape solutions, rapidly iterate, and ultimately field solutions faster

 Monitor and manage program progress across cost, schedule, and resource allocation, making tradeoffs that enable us to deliver best-in-class solutions to our customers on-time and on-budget at the stated production capacity rates

 Develop and implement lightweight processes, tools, and metrics for program planning, scope management, risk management, and customer communication to enable Anduril to move rapidly

 Be high ownership on all pieces of work and become a trusted partner and advisor to senior management

 Foster a creative, high-performance culture within the team, and proactively assess team skills versus needs, identifying personnel development or recruitment opportunities to strengthen the team’s capabilities

 Collaborate with finance and business development teams to develop novel pricing strategies for proposals that set Anduril up for long term financial and operational success

 Collaborate with senior management to develop and refine the strategic roadmap for Anduril Air Dominance & Strike R&D investments that underpin the success of our programs

 Work with functional owners to asses and understand current organizational capabilities, ensuring plan is comprehensive and maps path from today's capabilities to needed desired state for the business line, over months and years to come

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (technical background preferred)

 Minimum of 8 years experience managing production of complex technical systems

 Proven track record of successfully managing complex, multi-million-dollar production lines and driving their on-time, on-budget performance

 Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to move seamlessly between tactical and the 30,000 ft level

 Experience coordinating multiple internal and external teams within a complex engineering or technology-focused organization

 Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $241,000 — $319,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

records.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering, Space
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Senior Manager of Manufacturing Engineering to lead our manufacturing engineering efforts across multiple critical space programs. This pivotal role demands a visionary leader with deep technical expertise in advanced aerospace manufacturing, a proven track record of bringing complex space-qualified hardware from prototype to production, and an unwavering commitment to quality and mission success.

The Senior Manager will be responsible for overseeing manufacturing engineering teams and developing robust processes to ensure the successful fabrication, assembly, integration and test of high-reliability space components and systems. This individual will be instrumental in bridging the gap between design and production, ensuring manufacturability, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to the most stringent space-flight quality standards.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 Strategic and Technical Leadership: 

 
 Recruit, mentor, develop, and lead a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers and integration & test engineers and foster a culture of innovation, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 Serve as the primary manufacturing engineering lead for several assigned space programs, ensuring technical alignment and execution.

 Oversee the development, implementation, and optimization of manufacturing processes for complex, high-precision space-qualified hardware, including structures, propulsion, avionics, thermal systems, and optical components.

 Drive the vision and strategy for growing Anduril's space program, identifying new opportunities and areas for innovation.

 
 New Product Introduction:  

 
 Ensure robust Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles are integrated throughout the product lifecycle, influencing design decisions from early concept phases.

 Lead Manufacturing Readiness Reviews (MRR) and production readiness assessments.

 Lead Test Readiness Reviews (TRR) and test campaign readiness assessments.

 Oversee the design, development, documentation, and optimization of manufacturing processes for highly complex, space components, sub-systems, and integrated systems.

 Establish and enforce rigorous quality control standards and inspection methods, ensuring all hardware meets stringent space-grade requirements and a zero-defect mentality.

 Provide technical guidance on manufacturing facility layout, equipment selection, and tooling design for both pilot builds and production environments, including cleanroom operations.

 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: 

 
 Serve as the primary manufacturing engineering interface with Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, Test, and Operations.

 Collaborate with Supply Chain to assess supplier manufacturing capabilities, quality, and readiness for critical components.

 Support proposals, technical reviews, and customer briefings, representing manufacturing engineering capabilities and strategy.

 
  

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

  

 
 Degree in a technical field preferred such as engineering, math, or a hard science.

 At least 8+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably space and satellite manufacturing, systems engineering, or design of electromechanical hardware.

 Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment.

 Experience in unit-level/space vehicle/system integration, assembly, and environmental testing (eg., vibration, thermal vacuum, acoustic, shock, and EMI/EMC)

 Background in integration and testing of avionics/optical payloads, solar, propulsion, ADCS, or other space hardware.

 Proven team leadership skills, with examples of successfully managing and developing a diverse team.

 Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware through various methods (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.). Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.

 Possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly; apply them accurately; organize, schedule, and coordinate work phases; and, determine the appropriate approach at the task level or, with assistance, at the project level to provide solutions to a range of complex problems.

 Familiarity with CAD software, Manufacturing Execution systems, and ERP/MRP systems.

 A genuine interest in manufacturing and a thirst for learning, particularly in the space domain.

 Willingness to travel frequently (>25%) to support global manufacturing operations

 Demonstrated success in scaling product testing and production from one to tens/hundreds.

 Active security clearance or ability to obtain a security clearance.

 
  

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  

 
 Experience in test hardware and software development

 Software scripting experience in python

 Experience writing test plans, procedures, and work instruction documentation.

 Ability to work effectively in space manufacturing environments.

 Demonstrated skill at driving and questioning design and customer requirements.
