records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

The Senior Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) – Deployment Operations is responsible for executing and leading V-BAT flight operations in support of DoD and foreign customers in both land-based and maritime OCONUS environments. This is an operationally focused role requiring strong aviation judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to lead small teams in austere and high-visibility conditions. 

 

The Senior AVO is responsible for leading mission planning activities, performing comprehensive risk assessments, delivering pre-mission briefings, executing flight operations, and conducting structured post-flight debriefs. This role includes conducting Functional Check Flights (FCFs) and system validation as required, ensuring aircraft configuration control and logbook accuracy, coordinating with maintenance to sustain fleet readiness, and supporting overall operational discipline. The Senior AVO will mentor junior operators, serve as the on-site operational representative to customers, and travel extensively in support of deployments. 

 

This is not an entry-level flight operations role. The ideal candidate brings strong aviation fundamentals, disciplined cockpit habits, and mature operational decision-making. records.title: Staff Engineer, Quality (R5512)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

At Shield AI, we’re building advanced autonomous aircraft that are redefining what is possible, and we are looking for a Staff Quality Engineer to help ensure our products meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety. In this role, you will lead quality initiatives across the product lifecycle, driving improvements from early design and new product introduction through full-rate production.

 

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust quality systems in alignment with AS9100 standards, leading root cause investigations and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. You will partner closely with engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams to identify risks, improve process capability, and ensure consistent product quality. Your work will include supporting NPI efforts, establishing control plans and inspection strategies, and using data-driven methods to monitor and improve manufacturing performance.


As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping quality strategy, mentoring team members, and influencing cross-functional decisions without direct authority. This is an opportunity to work hands on with next generation aerospace technology and contribute directly to the delivery of highly reliable autonomous systems that will define the future of aviation.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)

 - 5+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering roles

 - Demonstrated experience leading root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions (RCA/CAPA)

 - Strong knowledge of quality systems and standards (AS9100 or similar)

 - Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) and scaling production in a manufacturing environment

 - Proficiency in statistical analysis and process control methods (SPC, capability analysis, etc.)

 - Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lean Six Sigma certification, or equivalent

 - Knowledge of design for quality principles, including DFMEA, tolerance analysis, and design reviews

 - Experience working with quality and manufacturing systems (QMS, MES, PLM) and data analysis tools

 - Familiarity with advanced inspection or test methods (metrology, NDT, automated inspection, etc.)

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

 

Shield AI builds autonomy systems for defense applications, including air, maritime, and space platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

We are building the AI Factory Reference Architecture, a Kubernetes-native platform for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying next-generation AI systems.

The AI Factory serves two purposes. Internally, it powers autonomy development across Hivemind and other AI programs. Externally, it becomes the reference architecture deployed into customer environments, spanning commercial cloud, on-premise infrastructure, sovereign deployments, and fully air-gapped systems.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to help define and build this platform. You will partner closely with ML researchers, platform engineers, and autonomy teams to deliver an exceptional developer experience for training and deploying modern AI models.

Success in this role requires balancing researcher productivity, platform simplicity, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability. You will work hands-on across the stack, helping shape both the platform architecture and its implementation while staying closely aligned with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - AI Platform Development: Lead the design and implementation of the AI Factory Reference Architecture, delivering a Kubernetes-native platform for AI development, distributed training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment.

 - AI Research Enablement: Partner directly with ML researchers to understand evolving training workflows and ensure the platform supports state-of-the-art AI frameworks, foundation model development, reinforcement learning, distributed training, and emerging research workflows.

 - Developer Experience: Design self-service AI development workflows that enable engineers to move seamlessly from local experimentation to large-scale distributed execution using familiar open source tools and frameworks.

 - Distributed AI Infrastructure: Build the infrastructure required to support distributed training, simulation, inference, and reinforcement learning workloads. Evaluate and integrate orchestration, scheduling, and resource management technologies to maximize scalability and developer productivity.

 - Compute Platform: Design and optimize shared GPU infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. Improve resource utilization, scheduling efficiency, storage, networking, observability, and overall platform reliability.

 - Data & Model Lifecycle: Build platform capabilities that enable dataset management, experiment tracking, artifact management, model versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement.

 - Platform Distribution: Develop repeatable deployment and lifecycle management solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices. Support commercial cloud, customer-managed infrastructure, sovereign environments, and fully air-gapped deployments.

 - Technology Leadership: Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and establish architectural patterns that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, autonomy teams, infrastructure engineers, and product teams to ensure the platform evolves alongside customer needs and advances in AI.

Key Outcomes:

 - 

 - Engineers move from idea to distributed training in hours instead of days.

 - High GPU utilization through efficient scheduling with KAI on Kubernetes.

 - Researchers use modern AI tooling without unnecessary platform friction.

 - AI Workspaces become the standard development environment across autonomy programs.

 - Training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment operate as a unified platform.

 - The AI Factory Reference Architecture can be deployed consistently across cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped environments.

 - Platform capabilities are reusable across multiple autonomy programs and customer deployments.

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience building Kubernetes-native AI or MLOps platforms supporting distributed machine learning workloads.

 - Deep understanding of modern AI training frameworks, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and distributed training techniques.

 - Experience operating GPU-accelerated infrastructure and distributed training systems.

 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, networking, security, storage, and distributed systems.

 - Experience with GPU scheduling concepts and large-scale AI workloads.

 - Experience packaging and deploying cloud-native infrastructure using Terraform and Helm.

 - Strong software engineering skills in Python and Golang and modern cloud-native technologies.

 - Experience collaborating closely with ML researchers to translate research workflows into scalable platform capabilities.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience with Ray or other distributed AI orchestration frameworks.

 - Experience with KAI, Slurm or other GPU scheduling technologies.

 - Experience supporting reinforcement learning, simulation-driven training, robotics, or autonomy workloads.

 - Experience deploying and optimizing AI models for edge hardware.

 - Experience designing infrastructure for classified, sovereign, or air-gapped environments.

 - Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.

 - Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure projects.

Why Join Us

 - The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.
 
 As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will help build the reference architecture used internally by our engineering teams and delivered to customers building their own AI capabilities. Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.
 
 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of modern AI, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and defense, building a platform that enables the next generation of autonomy systems while leveraging the best of the open-source AI ecosystem.

records.title: Staff Engineer, Integration Advance Manufacturing (R5187)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a highly cross-functional Staff Integration Advance Manufacturing Engineer to lead final system integration and production readiness activities for complex aerospace and defense platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring successful integration of electrical, mechanical, propulsion, and mission systems into complete operational vehicles and assemblies. 

The ideal candidate has broad multidisciplinary manufacturing experience and thrives in highly integrated production environments. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead manufacturing integration activities across electrical, mechanical, propulsion, and vehicle systems  

 - Develop and optimize final assembly and integration processes  

 - Coordinate system-level builds, integration sequencing, and production flow planning  

 - Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 

 - Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for integration and assembly issues 

 - Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  

 - Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 

 - Support system integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities 

 - Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 

 - Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 

 - Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 

 - Mentor junior manufacturing engineers 

Tools & skills:

 - 

 - MES & QMS systems,

 - 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems

 - Supplier manufacturing processes

 - 5S/visual management

 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). 

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 7+ years of manufacturing engineering or systems integration experience  

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical field  

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Experience with:  

 - Electrical and mechanical integration  

 - Production operations  

 - Manufacturing process development  

 - DFM/DFA principles  

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

 - Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  

 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  

 - Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies  

Preferred qualifications;

 - 

 - Aerospace or defense integration experience  

 - Experience supporting autonomous systems, UAVs, or advanced mobility platforms  

 - Familiarity with low-rate initial production (LRIP) and production scaling  

 - Experience with factory integration and manufacturing line design  

 - Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 

 - Proficiency in CAD software 

#LI-JM1

#LD

 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

 

###

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.title: Staff Engineer, Composite Advance Manufacturing
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

As a Staff Composites Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution. 

What You'll Do:

 - 

 - Act as a technical leader across programs, owning the design and optimization of high-impact manufacturing processes. 

 - Drive the scale-up of our flagship product line, balancing throughput, quality, and cost. 

 - Lead the manufacturing engineering effort for launching a new production line for a larger and more capable jet. 

 - Develop CPD/Fibersim definitions & producibility assessments for composite parts.

 - Scope and deploy critical production infrastructure, including manufacturing equipment, tooling, and hardware/software systems. 

 - Engage with vendors to source and integrate capital equipment, production tools, and automation systems. 

 - Mentor engineers and production personnel to build organizational capability and technical depth. 

 - Champion cross-functional initiatives that standardize and improve manufacturing performance at scale. 

Required Qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor’s degree in  Engineering, or a related field, or relevant experience.

 - 7+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, with a focus in rapid growth environments.

 - Proficiency in CAD software (Solidwork, NX, or CATIA).

 - Experience with Composite Part Design (CPD), or Fibersim, and Generative Shape Design (GSD).

 - Experience in owning the scale of production processes in a startup or rapid-growth environment.

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing composites processes, including machining, lamination, and/or assembly.

 - Experience with process improvement methodologies, such as Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma.

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001.

 - Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as additive manufacturing or automation systems.

 - Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and data-driven decision-making in a manufacturing context.

 - Hands-on experience with manufacturing equipment and tooling design.

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Staff Electromechanical Systems Advance Manufacturing Engineer to support the manufacturing and integration of complex motion-control and mechanically actuated systems across advanced aerospace and defense platforms. This role focuses on electromechanical assemblies involving actuators, hydraulics, pneumatics, motors, pumps, and integrated mechanical/electrical subsystems. 

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced production environments and has experience developing robust manufacturing processes for highly integrated systems. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead manufacturing engineering efforts for electromechanical subsystems and assemblies 

 - Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 

 - Actuators 

 - Motors and drives 

 - Hydraulic systems 

 - Pneumatic systems 

 - Pumps and fluid systems 

 - Powertrain components 

 - Motion-control assemblies 

 - Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 

 - Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for electromechanical manufacturing issues 

 - Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  

 - Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews 

 - Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 

 - Support system integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities 

 - Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 

 - Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 

 - Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 

 - Mentor junior manufacturing engineers

Tools & skills:

 - 

 - MES & QMS systems

 - 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems

 - Supplier manufacturing processes

 - 5S/visual management

 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in experience in electromechanical systems 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Experience with:  

 - Actuators and motion systems  

 - Hydraulics and pneumatics  

 - Mechanical/electrical integration  

 - Precision mechanical assemblies 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

 - Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  

 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  

 - Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies  

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Aerospace, defense, robotics, or automotive industry experience  

 - Experience with servo systems and motor control assemblies  

 - Knowledge of GD&T and mechanical inspection methods  

 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing and production optimization 

 - Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 

 - Proficiency in CAD software 

#LI-JM1

#LD

 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

 

###

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Staff Propulsion Systems Manufacturing Engineer to lead manufacturing engineering activities for advanced propulsion and fluid systems used in aerospace and defense applications. This role supports engine integration, fuel systems, oil systems, pumps, and related propulsion hardware from development through production. 

The ideal candidate has deep experience with propulsion-related manufacturing processes, fluid systems integration, and production support for mission-critical hardware. 

What you'll do:

 - Lead manufacturing engineering support for propulsion and fluid system assemblies  

 - Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 

 - Engines and propulsion systems  

 - Fuel systems and fuel tanks  

 - Oil and lubrication systems  

 - Pumps and fluid control hardware  

 - Aerospace vector and thrust systems  

 - Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 

 - Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for propulsion manufacturing issues 

 - Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  

 - Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews 

 - Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 

 - Support system integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities 

 - Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 

 - Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 

 - Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 

 - Mentor junior manufacturing engineers 

Tools & skills:

 - MES & QMS systems

 - 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems

 - Supplier manufacturing processes

 - 5S/visual management

 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Required qualifications:

 - 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience supporting propulsion or fluid systems  

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Experience with:  

 - Engine assembly and integration  

 - Fuel and oil systems  

 - Precision fluid system manufacturing  

 - Aerospace propulsion hardware  

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

 - Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  

 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  

 - Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies  

Preferred qualifications:

 - Aerospace or defense industry experience  

 - Experience supporting turbine, piston, hybrid-electric, or UAV propulsion systems  

 - Knowledge of pressure systems, leak testing, and fluid handling  

 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing and production optimization 

 - Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 

 - Proficiency in CAD software

#LD

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Staff Advance Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Define the Bill of Process and manufacturing sequence for assigned subassemblies or cells.

 - Map MBOM to operations, tooling needs, and process controls.

 - Build ergonomic workstations (height/reach zones, shadow boards, calibrated torque tools, ESD controls, POU materials).

 - Create visual, operator-ready Work Instructions with torque specs, PPE, inspection points, and MES revision control.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Staff Ground Vehicle Advance  uyoiypoiManufacturing Engineer to support the development and production of advanced ground mobility and vehicle systems. This role focuses on mechanical and integrated systems including chassis, suspension, braking, hydraulics, pneumatics, and mobility platforms. 

The ideal candidate has strong experience in automotive, heavy vehicle, or defense vehicle manufacturing environments and is comfortable supporting both prototype and production operations. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead manufacturing engineering activities for vehicle and mobility systems  

 - Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 

 - Chassis and structural assemblies  

 - Suspension and braking systems  

 - Wheels, axles, and driveline components  

 - Hydraulic and pneumatic systems  

 - Trailer and mobility platforms  

 - Support vehicle integration, testing, and production readiness activities  

 - Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 

 - Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing issues  

 - Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  

 - Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews 

 - Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 

 - Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 

 - Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 

 - Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 

 - Mentor junior manufacturing engineers 

Tools & skills:

 - 

 - MES & QMS systems

 - 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems

 - Supplier manufacturing processes

 - 5S/visual management

 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in automotive, mobility, heavy equipment, or defense vehicle systems 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related field 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Experience with:  

 - Vehicle integration and assembly  

 - Hydraulics and pneumatics  

 - Chassis and braking systems  

 - Mechanical production systems 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

 - Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  

 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  

 - Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies  

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Automotive OEM, defense vehicle, or off-road vehicle experience  

 - Experience supporting prototype-to-production transitions  

 - Knowledge of welding, fabrication, and structural assembly processes  

 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing and production optimization 

 - Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 

 - Proficiency in CAD software

records.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Automation Equipment
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Staff Manufacturing Engineer to lead the design and implementation of production automation equipment for advanced manufacturing. This engineer will own the technical scope from process definition and analytical sizing through concept development, detailed design, system integration, FAT, installation, SAT, production ramp, and handoff. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Develop analytical models for takt time, cycle time, OEE, capacity, buffers, labor, utilities, reliability, and overall automation-system performance.

 - Research and qualify advanced automation technologies that improve manufacturability, process capability, throughput, safety, and maintainability.

 - Lead process definition, concept development, and detailed engineering design for automation cells, tooling, fixtures, robot end effectors, motion systems, material handling, guarding, and service access.

 - Develop RFQs, equipment and functional specifications, interface requirements, procedures, verification plans, and FAT/SAT acceptance protocols.

 - Define integrated mechanical, electrical, controls, robot, vision, servo-motion, recipe, traceability, fault-recovery, and Digital Factory interface requirements.

 - Own automation projects from design reviews through risk-mitigation planning, build, debug, installation, commissioning, ramp, and production handoff.

 - Execute PFMEA, control-plan development, MSA, capability studies, fault-recovery testing, FAT, SAT, and rate demonstrations.

 - Troubleshoot equipment and process failures, implement corrective actions, and improve quality, availability, MTBF, MTTR, and lifecycle support. 

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

 - 10+ years designing, developing, integrating, or commissioning industrial automation equipment.

 - Strong mechanical design experience with machinery, tooling, fixtures, GD&T, tolerance analysis, servo mechanisms, pneumatics, hydraulics, guarding, and machine safety.

 - Working knowledge of Siemens PLCs, HMIs, FANUC robots, PROFINET and PROFIsafe, machine vision, servo systems, and manufacturing-data interfaces.

 - Proficiency with Siemens NX, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar CAD tools and the ability to review electrical and controls documentation.

 - Experience leading system integrators and complex automation projects from concept through production handoff while managing technical scope, schedule, risk, and supplier performance.

 - Working knowledge of applicable OSHA, NFPA, UL, ANSI, and ISO Standards. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience with automated electromechanical assembly, servo-press, calibration, functional-test, hydraulic-test, or endurance-test systems.

 - Experience with automated cutting, forming, welding, cleaning, leak-test, or pressure-test equipment.

 - Experience with robotic coating, mixing and dispensing, cure-control, or inspection systems.

 - Experience with automated drilling, fastening, sealant dispensing, metrology, or large-assembly handling,  

 - Experience with Digital Factory interfaces, serialized genealogy, and equipment-data integration. 

#LI-JM1

#LD

 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

 

###

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Electrical Systems Advance Manufacturing Engineer to lead the development, integration, and production support of advanced electrical systems for complex aerospace and defense platforms. This role is responsible for driving manufacturability, production readiness, process development, root cause resolution, and continuous improvement across electrical assemblies and subsystems. 

The ideal candidate has deep experience supporting low-rate to high-rate production environments involving avionics, wiring harnesses, PCBAs, power systems, batteries, sensors, and mission-critical electrical hardware. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead manufacturing engineering activities for electrical and avionics systems from prototype through full-rate production 

 - Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 

 - Wiring harnesses and EWIS 

 - PCB/PCBA assemblies 

 - Avionics systems 

 - Power distribution systems 

 - Batteries and energy storage systems 

 - Sensors and navigation systems 

 - Mission system integration 

 - Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 

 - Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for electrical manufacturing issues 

 - Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  

 - Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews 

 - Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 

 - Develop electrical assembly standards, inspection methods, and quality control processes 

 - Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 

 - Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 

 - Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 

 - Mentor junior manufacturing engineers 

Tools & skills:

 - 

 - MES & QMS systems

 - 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems

 - Supplier manufacturing processes

 - 5S/visual management

 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience supporting complex electrical systems  

 - Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field  

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Experience with:  

 - Wiring harness manufacturing  

 - EWIS standards  

 - PCB/PCBA manufacturing and assembly  

 - Electrical integration and troubleshooting  

 - Aerospace or defense electrical systems  

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

 - Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  

 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  

 - Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies  

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Aerospace or defense industry experience 

 - IPC certification familiarity (IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620) 

 - Experience supporting flight hardware or mission-critical systems 

 - Knowledge of automated test systems and electrical validation 

 - Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 

 - Proficiency in CAD software

#LD

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

At Shield AI, we’re building advanced autonomous aircraft that are redefining what is possible, and we are looking for a Staff Quality Engineer to help ensure our products meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety. In this role, you will lead quality initiatives across the product lifecycle, driving improvements from early design and new product introduction through full-rate production.

 

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust quality systems in alignment with AS9100 standards, leading root cause investigations and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. You will partner closely with engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams to identify risks, improve process capability, and ensure consistent product quality. Your work will include supporting NPI efforts, establishing control plans and inspection strategies, and using data-driven methods to monitor and improve manufacturing performance.


As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping quality strategy, mentoring team members, and influencing cross-functional decisions without direct authority. This is an opportunity to work hands on with next generation aerospace technology and contribute directly to the delivery of highly reliable autonomous systems that will define the future of aviation.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)

 - 5+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering roles

 - Demonstrated experience leading root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions (RCA/CAPA)

 - Strong knowledge of quality systems and standards (AS9100 or similar)

 - Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) and scaling production in a manufacturing environment

 - Proficiency in statistical analysis and process control methods (SPC, capability analysis, etc.)

 - Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lean Six Sigma certification, or equivalent

 - Knowledge of design for quality principles, including DFMEA, tolerance analysis, and design reviews

 - Experience working with quality and manufacturing systems (QMS, MES, PLM) and data analysis tools

 - Familiarity with advanced inspection or test methods (metrology, NDT, automated inspection, etc.)

*Compensation for this role is based on the position’s work location. The salary range shown reflects the listed location and may vary if the position is based in a different geographic market. Actual compensation will also consider factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

records.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Advanced Manufacturing
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

As a Senior Staff Advance Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution.

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Define the Bill of Process and manufacturing sequence for assigned subassemblies or cells. 

 - Map MBOM to operations, tooling needs, and process controls. 

 - Build ergonomic workstations (height/reach zones, shadow boards, calibrated torque tools, ESD controls, POU materials). 

 - Create visual, operator-ready Work Instructions with torque specs, PPE, inspection points, and MES revision control. 

 - Conduct time studies, compute takt/CT, identify bottlenecks, and lead kaizen improvements. 

 - Establish standardized work, visual controls, job aids, and layered audit systems; iterate with operators. 

 - Capture shop-floor lessons learned defects, build issues, tooling feedback and drive root cause and corrective action. 

 - Partner with Quality on in-process checks, error-proofing, and FAI readiness. 

 - Implement ECOs, validate process updates, and maintain work instructions accordingly. 

 - Tools & Skills: MES/QMS systems, torque analyzers, Minitab/Excel (SPC, capability, DOE), lean/5S, PFMEA, ergonomic assessment tools, Control Plans, Standard Operating Procedures. 

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 10+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production systems, process development, or assembly engineering. 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Mechatronics, or related STEM field. 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including machining, composites, avionics and/or assembly. 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001. 

 - Proficiency in CAD software 

 - Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as additive manufacturing or automation systems. 

 - Hands-on experience with manufacturing equipment and tooling design. 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines

records.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Operations Analysis (R5869)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Senior Lead Operational Analyst to contribute to the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s aircraft systems. In this role, you will perform analysis at the component, system, mission and campaign levels to evaluate the effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our aircraft across multiple domains, missions and applications. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and defense stakeholders to assess system performance, inform design trade-offs, and improve mission outcomes. 


This position requires a strong working knowledge of military operations, modeling & simulation (M&S), data science, and operational analysis techniques. Your analyses will directly support product decisions and customer engagements by helping demonstrate how Shield AI’s AI-powered platforms perform in realistic and contested operational environments. 

What you'll do:

 - Plan, own and execute operational analyses to assess the effectiveness of autonomous systems in representative military scenarios.

 - Develop and run modeling, simulation, and wargaming analyses to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational findings into actionable system insights.

 - Perform trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance across varying operational conditions, assumptions, and threat environments.

 - Build, modify, and analyze mission-level models using tools such as AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python, or similar M&S frameworks.

 - Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor performance, and autonomy-enabled behaviors to support mission effectiveness assessments.

 - Engage with DoD stakeholders, operators, and analysts to understand mission needs and operational constraints.

 - Contribute to the development and refinement of concepts of operations (CONOPS) for AI-enabled aircraft capabilities.

 - Monitor emerging threats and operational challenges relevant to autonomous and air combat systems.

 - Prepare technical documentation, analysis reports, and briefings for internal teams, customers, and government stakeholders. 

 - Apply modern compute and development best practices (e.g., version control, scripting, scalable compute workflows, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable analysis pipelines.

 - Be a force multiplier by coaching and developing incoming talent.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering or math domain.

 - Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation, operations research, or related defense or aerospace roles.

 - Active Secret at a minimum.  

 - Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
 
 - Experience with evaluating strategic development and analysis goals for multi-mission/multi-domain applicability.

 - Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, tools (Brawler, ESAMS, etc.), Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
 
 - Experience leading a product effort from pre-shaping to tactical deployment

 - Prior experience in systems engineering product development lifecycle (SysML or MBSE preferred)
 
 -  Experience developing technical expertise in a team to execute analyses for system design and analysis.

 - Preferred Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

records.title: Senior Manager, Supplier Quality (R6220)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shield AI is actively seeking candidates with deep expertise in manufacturing and quality methodologies, paired with a relentless drive to enable supplier success and strengthen mission-critical operations.

Shield AI’s Supply Chain Quality team is responsible for global quality oversight across our supplier base. The team reduces supply-chain risk through supplier assessments and internal risk reviews, proactively drives supplier qualification and development activities.

In this role, you will lead a supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, development, performance management, and quality assurance across Shield AI’s aerospace and defense supply base. You will set supplier-quality priorities; manage team capacity, technical execution, and resource allocation; and develop high-performing quality leaders. The role also oversees supplier audits, nonconformance resolution, root-cause investigations, and hands on hardware dispositions.

You will evaluate supplier capability, quality performance, organizational risk, and resource needs to ensure purchased hardware and materials meet Shield AI engineering, customer, regulatory, and quality requirements. As an experienced aerospace quality leader, you will partner closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Program teams to resolve complex supplier-quality issues, improve supplier capability, and reduce quality and delivery risk across the supply base.

What you'll do:

 - Develop the supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, surveillance, performance management, and corrective-action activities across Shield AI’s global aerospace and defense supply base.

 - Establish supplier-quality priorities, allocate resources, and translate functional objectives into staffing, workload, and execution plans that support product, program, and organizational needs.

 - Develop Supplier Quality leaders and engineering personnel through coaching, performance management, succession planning, workforce development, and technical mentorship.

 - Oversee supplier qualification, risk assessments, periodic performance reviews, supplier audits, source inspections, and approved-supplier status across complex aerospace hardware, commodities, and manufacturing processes.

 - Ensure supplier requirements are effectively flowed down and that suppliers comply with applicable quality management system, engineering, customer, contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.

 - Escalate significant supplier-quality risks and direct SCARs, supplier recovery efforts, and capability-improvement plans that could affect product quality, delivery, mission readiness, or program execution.

 - Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams to address supplier producibility, design-for-manufacturability, process capability, technical execution, and quality risks.

 - Advance supplier-quality processes, business systems, data analytics, and continuous-improvement practices that strengthen supplier capability, product quality, delivery performance, and supply-base resilience.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or another related technical discipline.

 - At least 7 years of relevant experience, including 2–5 years of leadership or people-management experience with direct responsibility for Quality Engineering and/or Supplier Quality Engineering personnel.

 - Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 quality-management systems, as well as aerospace and defense supplier-quality requirements.

 - Demonstrated proficiency in root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving methods, including 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.

 - Experience with supplier qualification, supplier development, PPAP, and First Article Inspection processes, including AS9102 requirements.

 - Understanding of ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and other requirements applicable to aerospace and defense suppliers.

 - Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including coaching, performance management, organizational development, and building high-performing technical teams.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration, executive communication, and supplier relationship-management skills.

 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.

 - Experience using ERP/MRP systems.

 - Ability to travel to Shield AI manufacturing locations and supplier sites domestically and, as needed, internationally—up to approximately 20% of the time.

Preferred qualifications:

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Manager (CQM), or equivalent quality certification.

 - Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.

 - Experience leading supplier-quality functions in a high-growth aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, or advanced-manufacturing environment.

 - Experience supporting the production and qualification of complex electromechanical, electronic, precision-machined, composite, or avionics hardware.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


ABOUT SHIELD AI:

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We’re looking for a hands-on manufacturing leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production. 

You will lead prototype build execution and the manufacturing setup of our new Seattle-area facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll build the production team, establish the factory’s operating system and deliver the readiness needed to scale aircraft production safely, reliably and efficiently. 

This role carries accountability across the full journey: turning lessons from development builds into a repeatable production system, then leading that operation against safety, quality, delivery and cost commitments. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management to make that happen. 

What you'll do:

 - Lead prototype builds and new product introduction 
 
 - Own the day-to-day execution of X-BAT prototype and development aircraft builds, including assembly, integration, rework and build support for testing. 
 
 - Partner with Program Management to establish achievable build schedules, resource plans and milestones, making constraints and trade-offs visible early. 
 
 - Work with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering through build-test-learn cycles, ensuring build issues are captured, resolved and reflected in future designs and production processes. 
 
 - Plan and execute pre-series builds to prove tooling, work instructions, material flow, process controls and workforce readiness before production ramp. 
 
 - Maintain configuration discipline and aircraft traceability throughout development builds in partnership with Engineering and Quality. 
 
 Establish the Seattle production operation 
 
 - Lead manufacturing setup and operational readiness for X-Forge 3, working with Facilities and Manufacturing Engineering on factory layout, equipment installation, commissioning and production flow. 
 
 - Recruit, develop and lead the production organization, building capable frontline leadership and a skilled aircraft assembly team. 
 
 - Own production staffing, training and capacity plans, aligning investment and workforce growth with program demand. 
 
 - Drive launch readiness across people, tooling, materials, processes and quality, with clear owners and closure plans for gaps. 
 
 - Lead the transition from prototype operations into Seattle production, ensuring build knowledge and lessons learned transfer with the work. 
 
 Deliver and scale aircraft production 
 
 - Own production execution against safety, quality, delivery and cost targets as X-BAT moves through initial production and into sustained rate. 
 
 - Establish daily operating routines, visual management and escalation processes that surface problems early and drive timely resolution. 
 
 - Improve throughput, labor productivity, first-pass quality and schedule adherence through practical Lean methods and structured problem-solving. 
 
 - Partner with Supply Chain and Planning to align material availability, supplier readiness and outsourced manufacturing with the production plan. 
 
 - Work with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality to eliminate recurring build issues and embed permanent corrective actions. 
 
 - Deploy digital manufacturing tools and appropriate automation to improve execution, traceability and scalability. 
 
 - Give leadership a clear view of production performance, launch readiness, risks and the decisions needed to maintain progress. 

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing or a related technical field. 

 - 10+ years of experience in aerospace or comparable advanced manufacturing, including at least 5 years leading production teams. 

 - Demonstrated experience leading prototype or new product introduction builds and carrying a product into sustained production. 

 - Proven ability to build and scale manufacturing operations, including workforce development, capacity planning and production systems. 

 - Experience leading complex assembly and integration operations with demanding quality, configuration and traceability requirements. 

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing readiness, tooling validation, material coordination and production launch. 

 - Track record of improving safety, quality, delivery and cost through Lean manufacturing and structured problem-solving. 

 - Ability to lead across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management, resolving competing priorities and driving clear accountability. 

 - A hands-on leadership style, with the ability to move between long-term factory planning and detailed problem-solving on the floor. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through initial and rate production. 

 - Experience establishing a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites. 

 - Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration and production test. 

 - Familiarity with aerospace quality systems, including AS9100, and digital manufacturing and traceability tools. 

 - Experience managing production interfaces with outsourced manufacturing partners and complex supplier networks. 

 - Advanced degree or relevant training in manufacturing leadership, program management or production launch. 

#LF

 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

 

###

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.title: Staff Engineer, Advanced Manufacturing (R6311)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

As the Staff Advance Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution.

 
 

What you'll do:

 - Define the Bill of Process and manufacturing sequence for assigned subassemblies or cells. 

 - Map MBOM to operations, tooling needs, and process controls. 

 - Build ergonomic workstations (height/reach zones, shadow boards, calibrated torque tools, ESD controls, POU materials). 

 - Create visual, operator-ready Work Instructions with torque specs, PPE, inspection points, and MES revision control. 

 - Conduct time studies, compute takt/CT, identify bottlenecks, and lead kaizen improvements. 

 - Establish standardized work, visual controls, job aids, and layered audit systems; iterate with operators. 

 - Capture shop-floor lessons learned defects, build issues, tooling feedback and drive root cause and corrective action. 

 - Partner with Quality on in-process checks, error-proofing, and FAI readiness. 

 - Implement ECOs, validate process updates, and maintain work instructions accordingly. 

 - Tools & Skills: MES/QMS systems, torque analyzers, Minitab/Excel (SPC, capability, DOE), lean/5S, PFMEA, ergonomic assessment tools, Control Plans, Standard Operating Procedures. 

Required qualifications:

 - 7+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production systems, process development, or assembly engineering. 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Mechatronics, or related STEM field. 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including machining, composites, avionics and/or assembly. 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001. 

 - Proficiency in CAD software 

 - Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as additive manufacturing or automation systems. 

 - Hands-on experience with manufacturing equipment and tooling design. 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines. 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

 

###

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Compensation Director, Aircraft Engineering and Manufacturing, serves as the strategic compensation leader for the Aircraft division, providing enterprise-level oversight for compensation programs supporting manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, logistics, customer success, and skilled trades. This role defines compensation strategy for large, complex employee populations while ensuring programs are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. 

As the organization's subject matter expert for manufacturing and operations compensation, the Director partners closely with business leaders, Px Business Partners, Finance, and Legal to design compensation programs that enable business growth, talent attraction, workforce scalability, and operational excellence. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in manufacturing compensation strategy, non-exempt workforce design, market intelligence, and executive consulting, with a demonstrated ability to influence enterprise decisions and build compensation frameworks that support rapidly growing operations. 

What you'll do:

Compensation Strategy & Enterprise Leadership 

 - Develop and lead the compensation strategy supporting Aircraft manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, logistics, customer success, and skilled trades populations.  

 - Serve as the SME on manufacturing and operations compensation, shaping long-term compensation philosophy and governance.  

 - Partner with business leadership to align compensation strategy with business growth, workforce planning, organizational design, and operational priorities.  

 - Drive compensation initiatives supporting facility expansions, new business models, geographic growth, and workforce transformation.  

Manufacturing & Operations Compensation 

 - Lead the design and evolution of compensation structures supporting large non-exempt employee populations.  

 - Establish wage structures, geographic differentials, shift premium strategies, progression frameworks, and other compensation programs that balance external competitiveness with internal equity.  

 - Oversee market pricing methodologies utilizing Radford, Mercer, WTW, and specialized manufacturing compensation surveys alongside complementary market intelligence.  

 - Develop innovative compensation approaches to attract and retain highly competitive manufacturing, technical, and operational talent. 

Executive Partnership & Business Consulting 

 - Serve as the trusted compensation advisor to Aircraft executives and business leaders.  

 - Consult on organization design, workforce investments, location strategy, and talent acquisition decisions with significant financial and organizational impact in partnership with the Px Business Partner.  

 - Provide strategic guidance on compensation implications of organizational changes, acquisitions, new facilities, and business expansion.  

 - Present compensation recommendations and analyses to executive leadership with clear business rationale and risk assessments.  

Compensation Analytics & Insights 

 - Lead enterprise compensation analyses including market competitiveness, pay equity, workforce cost modeling, and incentive effectiveness.  

 - Translate complex compensation data into actionable insights for executive stakeholders.  

 - Anticipate market trends and proactively recommend compensation strategies that strengthen organizational competitiveness.  

Governance, Compliance & Program Excellence 

 - Establish governance frameworks, policies, and administration standards for manufacturing compensation programs.  

 - Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour regulations while mitigating organizational risk.  

 - Partner with Legal, Finance, and People Operations on complex compensation matters and regulatory changes.  

 - Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify compensation processes, improve scalability, and enhance operational efficiency. 

Leadership 

 - Champion best practices in compensation design, analytics, governance, and operational excellence.  

 - Build organizational capability through knowledge sharing, coaching, and development of compensation expertise across the People function.
